name: local-llm
description: Runs open-source LLMs on this machine's GPU with llama.cpp or Ollama. Admins pick a model and a runner in Settings; weights download only when Run is pressed. Needs a workspace GPU grant: ploinky gpu grant nvidia --agent local-llms/local-llm.

capabilities.summary: Serves the open-weight model an administrator runs on this workspace's GPU.
capabilities.whenToUse: Call soul_gateway/local-llms/local-llm/default for private, on-machine generation once a model is ready; it answers 503 not_ready otherwise.
